navigation.loadFailed: Could not load the game. Reload the menu to retry the download. Saved data has not been erased.

status.insufficientFunds: Not enough cash to buy this property.
status.building_sold: {actor} sold one building level on “{propertyName}” for {amount}.
status.mortgaged: {actor} mortgaged “{propertyName}” for {amount}. It no longer collects rent.
status.redeemed: {actor} repaid {amount} plus a {fee} fee to redeem “{propertyName}”.
status.rollPropertyAvailable: {actor} moved {steps} spaces to “{propertyName}”, available to buy.
status.rollRent: {actor} moved {steps} spaces; fixed rent due to {owner} for “{propertyName}”: {amount}.
status.cardMoved: {actor}: {message} Arrived at “{destination}”. No further Chance card is drawn on this move.
status.chanceIgnored: No further Chance card is drawn on this move.

items.title: Your items
items.discardReason: You received item {next}. Choose one to discard, including the new item. Your turn ends after this choice.
items.beforeRoll: Use an item before rolling on your own turn.
items.used: You have already used an item this turn.
items.busy: Finish the current animation or save before using an item.
items.controlled: Chosen dice total: {total}. No random dice are drawn.
items.swapped: Positions swapped with {target}; no landing payment or Start reward.
items.waived: {actor} owes no rent to {owner} at {property}; the landlord receives nothing.

chanceCards.retreat-three: Move back {steps} spaces; crossing Start earns nothing.
chanceCards.return-start: Teleport to Start and receive ¥{amount} once.
chanceCards.rent-waiver: Waive the first rent payment in this turn’s movement chain. Does not cover taxes or fines. Expires at turn end.
chanceCards.controlled-dice: Choose the next roll’s total ({min}–{max}). The dice are determined from your choice, not randomly rolled.
chanceCards.tax-discount: Pay {percent}% of the first tax-space fee this turn, rounded up. Does not cover rent or Chance fines. Expires at turn end.
chanceCards.construction-discount: Pay {percent}% for your next legal upgrade this turn, rounded up. Sale refunds and asset value use the actual cost. Expires at turn end.
chanceCards.swap-positions: Swap positions with another surviving player. No landing effect or Start reward. Then roll normally.

setup.title: New match
setup.spectating: You are eliminated. Watch the remaining players or return to Main Menu from Settings. Skip Animation only speeds presentation.
setup.nameError: Use 1–16 visible characters, or leave the name blank for the default.
setup.round_limit: The full round limit was reached. Ranked by net assets, then cash; equal results share the win.

handover.title: Pass the device
handover.instruction: Pass the device to the next player. Confirm only when they are ready; game shortcuts stay blocked until then.

statistics.tradeBookValueReceived: Book value of land received in trades
statistics.tradeBookValueGiven: Book value of land given in trades

results.replayDetail: Restart from the same seed and settings. Your choices may change the outcome.
results.notRecorded: This result has not been added to a permanent match history.

transfer.title: Import and recover saves
transfer.limit: Choose a .richman.json file of at most 1 MiB. Reading and validation do not replace your match.
transfer.replace: Confirmation replaces the current save and this page’s unsaved progress. Export any data you need first. A valid current snapshot becomes the backup; damaged data is replaced only with your confirmation. Continue from the menu afterwards.
transfer.imported: This will be an imported match, not a formal challenge score. The source label is not an anti-cheat guarantee.

errors.unavailable: The file or local storage could not be accessed. Your current match is preserved; retry when access is available.
errors.invalid: The data is invalid or cannot be exported unchanged. Your current match is preserved; choose a valid file or backup.
errors.incompatible: This file uses an unsupported format, map or rules version. Keep the original file; it has not replaced your match.
errors.conflict: Another page changed the save. Nothing was replaced. Read a fresh preview before confirming again.
errors.too_large: The file exceeds 1 MiB and was not read. Choose a smaller match file.
errors.backupUnavailable: No valid, supported backup is available. Current data is preserved; export it or choose a valid file.

storage.exportWarning: The file includes player names and the full match state. Keep it private unless you intend to share it.
storage.unsaved: This match has unsaved progress. The previous saved data is preserved.
storage.conflict: Another page changed the saved match. This page is paused and cannot overwrite it.
storage.discardWarning: Discarding loses only this page’s unsaved progress; it does not erase the saved match.
storage.preserved: The committed match is saved locally. Main Menu preserves it; playing again replaces it.
storage.replaceWarning: Starting this match replaces the current saved match. The previous valid snapshot is kept as a backup.
storage.unavailable: Local match storage is unavailable. You may start a match and choose to play without saving.
storage.invalid: The saved data is damaged or uses an unsupported version. It has not been erased.

assets.title: Public assets
assets.bankrupt: Eliminated; properties returned to the bank.
assets.publicOnly: Public assets only; no private cards or future random results.

history.title: Action history
history.count: Keeping the latest {limit} events; {count} currently stored.

construction.title: Build one level
construction.unavailable: Wait until the current action is saved and presented.

reasons.not_turn: Build before rolling on your own turn.
reasons.incomplete_group: Own every property in this color group first.
reasons.mortgaged: Redeem all mortgages in this group first.
reasons.unbalanced: Build on a lower-level property in this group first.

liquidity.title: Property operation
liquidity.mortgageEffect: Mortgaging also removes this group's rent bonus.

reasons.not_owner: Only the owner may manage this property.
reasons.not_turn: Manage property before rolling on your own turn.
reasons.insufficient_cash: Not enough cash for this payment.
reasons.unbalanced_sale: Sell a higher-level building in this group first.
reasons.group_has_buildings: Sell every building in this group before mortgaging.
reasons.no_mortgage_value: This property's mortgage value is zero.

debt.title: Settle fixed debt
debt.pending: The fixed debt must be resolved before play continues.
debt.automatic: Sell buildings or mortgage property. The first action that raises enough cash pays this fixed debt automatically; no extra payment confirmation is required.
debt.insolvent: Even cash plus all liquidation proceeds cannot cover the debt. Liquidation pays the available amount, writes off the rest, returns every property to the bank and eliminates this seat.
debt.solvent: Bankruptcy is not available while your assets can cover the debt.
debt.liquidated: {actor} liquidated assets for {amount} and was eliminated.

trade.title: Trade proposal
trade.limit: Up to {limit} properties per side. Transferred land must be unmortgaged, with no buildings anywhere in its color group.
trade.effect: Submitting uses your only proposal this turn. Only the recipient can then accept or reject it.

reasons.invalid_terms: Choose non-duplicate land or enter a positive whole cash amount.
reasons.not_owner: Ownership changed; this trade is no longer valid.
reasons.group_has_buildings: Sell every building in the affected color groups first.
reasons.insufficient_cash: The payer does not have enough cash.
reasons.amount_overflow: The resulting amount or statistics exceed the safe range.

botReasons.fair_value: Incoming value covers outgoing value, with sufficient cash.
botReasons.lower_value: Incoming value is lower than outgoing value.
botReasons.invalid_trade: The trade conditions are no longer valid.

auction.title: Property auction
auction.pending: The property auction must finish before the next turn.
auction.remaining: Cash if you win at this bid
auction.range: Whole-number bids in multiples of {step}, within your cash balance.
auction.passEffect: Passing is final for this auction. The last highest bidder pays their bid; if everyone passes, the property stays with the bank.
auction.all_passed: Everyone passed; {property} remains with the bank.
auction.no_bidders: No eligible bidder; {property} remains with the bank.

runtime.title: Richman 3D
runtime.paused: Paused. The completed action is preserved.
runtime.pointerLockFailed: Mouse lock was denied. All game buttons remain available.
runtime.presentation_failed: The 3D view is unavailable. The committed game state is preserved. You can return to the menu.
runtime.command_rejected: This action is no longer available. Choose a current action.
